title: Full Stack Engineer (M-Shaped)
description:
About This Role
**10 years of experience**  

**Skills: Java, Spring Boot, React.js, TypeScript, Microservices, REST APIs, GenAI, LLMs, LangChain, RAG, AWS / Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Client Engagement, Solution Design, Agile**

**About the Role**
  

We are looking for a Forward Deploy Engineer with 10\+ years of full stack experience across Java, React, and AI to work directly embedded within client environments. You will combine deep technical expertise in Java backend engineering, React frontend development, and AI / GenAI integration — acting as the technical face of the organisation with clients. This is a rare combination of hands\-on engineering excellence and strong client engagement skills — you will write production code, design solutions, and build trusted technical relationships with client engineering teams simultaneously.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Work embedded within client environments — delivering hands\-on Java, React, and AI engineering solutions directly alongside client engineering teams.
* Design and develop scalable Java microservices and REST APIs using Spring Boot applying clean architecture and SOLID principles.
* Build high\-performance React.js frontend applications using TypeScript, Redux, and modern JavaScript delivering exceptional user experiences.
* Design and integrate AI / GenAI solutions — RAG pipelines, LLM integrations, agentic workflows, and AI\-powered features — into enterprise Java and React applications.
* Own end\-to\-end feature delivery across backend, frontend, and AI layers — from architecture design through to production deployment.
* Act as the primary technical interface with client stakeholders — engaging engineering leads, architects, and CTOs with confidence, credibility, and technical authority.
* Identify and articulate client technical challenges — rapidly prototyping and delivering solutions that demonstrate immediate business value.
* Conduct architecture reviews and technical assessments within client environments — providing clear, actionable recommendations aligned to client technology strategy.
* Collaborate with internal product and engineering teams — feeding client insights, technical requirements, and AI use cases back into the product roadmap.
* Mentor client engineering teams — upskilling developers in Java, React, and AI engineering best practices through hands\-on pairing and knowledge sharing.

**What We're Looking For**


* 10\+ years of full stack engineering experience with deep proven expertise across Java backend, React frontend, and AI / GenAI integration in production environments.


* Deep Java proficiency including Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Cloud, Hibernate / JPA, and microservices design patterns.


* Strong React.js expertise including TypeScript, Redux / Context API, state management, and REST API integration in large\-scale enterprise applications.


* Proven AI / GenAI engineering experience including LLM integration, RAG pipeline design, prompt engineering, and agentic workflow development using LangChain or LlamaIndex.


* Strong cloud platform experience across AWS or Azure including Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipeline management.


* Exceptional client\-facing communication and stakeholder management skills — able to engage CTOs, engineering directors, and technical teams with authority and credibility.


* Proven ability to rapidly understand complex client environments, identify technical challenges, and deliver pragmatic, high\-quality solutions at pace.


* Experience working in client\-facing or consulting engineering roles — comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast\-moving, and high\-visibility client delivery environments.


* Strong system design and architecture skills — distributed systems, event\-driven architecture, and API\-first design.


* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — producing clear technical proposals, architecture documents, and client\-facing presentations.

title: Lead Full Stack Java Engineer - Vice President
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


The Applications Development Technology Lead is a senior level position responsible for building robust, high\-performance, large\-scale applications. The overall objective of this role is to lead applications systems analysis and programming activities.


**Responsibilities:**

  

  

* Partner with multiple management teams to ensure appropriate integration of functions to meet goals as well as identify and define necessary system enhancements to deploy new products and process improvements
* Resolve variety of high impact problems/projects through in\-depth evaluation of complex business processes, system processes, and industry standards
* Provide expertise in area and advanced knowledge of applications programming and ensure application design adheres to the overall architecture blueprint
* Utilize advanced knowledge of system flow and develop standards for coding, testing, debugging, and implementation
* Develop comprehensive knowledge of how areas of business, such as architecture and infrastructure, integrate to accomplish business goals
* Provide in\-depth analysis with interpretive thinking to define issues and develop innovative solutions
* Serve as advisor or coach to mid\-level developers and analysts, allocating work as necessary
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
**Qualifications:**
  

**\* 10\-15 years of relevant experience in Apps Development or systems analysis role**  

* **Extensive experience system analysis and in programming of software applications**
* **Hands\-on experience in Web technologies (HTML, CSS, React JS), REST\-APIs, Multithreading and Backend using Java/J2EE technologies.**
* **Strong fundamentals of OOPS (Object Oriented Programming Standards) Concepts, Data Structures, and Algorithms**
* Strong experience developing and architecting integrated solution with non\-functional requirements like scalability, high availability, consistency.
* Strong experience with API and Web Services development using REST/SOAP protocols
* Fundamental database concepts and experience with a relational database (MSSQL, Oracle) or NoSQL platforms.
* Ability and willingness to work across multiple tools, frameworks, and technology stacks.
* Fundamental understanding of and experience with cloud platforms such as Docker, Kubernetes
* A good understanding of Standard, Enterprise Design Patterns, and SOLID principles
* Should have good understanding of Containers, docker deployment.
* Strong knowledge with testing frameworks like JUNIT, Cucumber, Jasmine/Mocha
* Preferred experience in High\-Speed Messaging platforms such as KAFKA .
* Experience with Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery technologies and tools.
* Demonstrated leadership and project management skills
* Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication
  

  

**Education:**
  

* Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
* Master’s degree preferred

	+ Develop API services, integration layers, and backend components, including RESTful services, event\-driven processors, and reusable modules to enable seamless system integration across distributed environments
	+ Translate business requirements into robust workflow models and technical specifications
	+ Implement optimization, incident handling, compensation, retries, and error workflows following best practices

	+ Provide technical direction, mentorship, and best practice guidance
	+ Collaborate with cross functional engineering, QA, DevOps, and business stakeholders for end to end delivery
* Builder Responsibility:
	+ Design, develop, and deploy AI\-powered solutions using no\-code, low\-code, and advanced platforms, translating business needs into scalable applications that enhance products, workflows, and decision\-making
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* Undergraduate degree or equivalent experience
* 5\+ years of software engineering experience, including Java, Spring Boot, and microservices development
* Experience with distributed systems, message brokers (Kafka, Azure EventsHub), and REST APIs
* Experience working in Agile environments and delivering complex enterprise automation solutions

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with Azure/GCP cloud integration patterns
* Experience with event driven architectures and asynchronous processing
* Working knowledge with Camunda (integration from java code)
* Familiarity with container orchestration (Kubernetes/OpenShift)

* Exposure to Camunda Optimize, Tasklist, Operate for monitoring \& analytics

title: Senior Specialist, Full-Stack Engineer
description:
In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:


* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain full stack applications that support applied AI solutions, enterprise platform capabilities, and AI\-enabled product flows.
* The Vice President, Full Stack AI Developer will work closely with product managers, product owners, engineering leads, data scientists, platform teams, and governance partners to translate product needs into high\-quality technical solutions. The role requires strong engineering fundamentals, practical AI fluency, disciplined execution, and the ability to contribute across solution delivery, integration, testing, deployment, production readiness, and ongoing platform support.
* Support applied AI solution delivery by integrating AI/ML capabilities, model outputs, prompts, automation workflows, data services, APIs, and enterprise systems into reliable product experiences.
* Provide platform support for AI capabilities, including enhancements, defect resolution, release support, troubleshooting, performance improvements, and maintainability.
* Support AI product enhancement across platforms by improving existing workflows, adding new capabilities, integrating reusable components, and ensuring solutions scale across business and technology environments.
* Partner with product owners, product managers, data scientists, and engineering teams to translate requirements into clear technical designs, implementation plans, and working software.
* Develop well\-designed, testable, efficient, and maintainable code to solve business and technology problems.
* Participate in solution design, code reviews, technical documentation, testing, release planning, deployment activities, and production readiness.
* Support application quality through automated testing, software verification, debugging, performance tuning, and secure coding practices.
* Troubleshoot, debug, upgrade, and enhance existing systems while managing technical debt and improving software maintainability.
* Ensure software solutions are aligned to enterprise architecture, security, privacy, resiliency, observability, and change management standards.
* Leverage existing products, reusable components, and platform capabilities to improve engineering efficiency and avoid duplication.
* Collaborate across product, engineering, data science, platform, operations, risk, and governance teams to deliver high\-quality AI\-enabled capabilities.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:


* Preferred 10\+ years of experience in software development, full stack engineering, application development, platform support, or related technology roles.
* Experience developing, supporting, and enhancing enterprise applications using modern application, API, integration, and platform technologies.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle practices, Agile delivery, CI/CD, automated testing, code reviews, release management, and production support.
* Experience building secure, scalable, testable, and maintainable software in complex enterprise environments.
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled applications, automation platforms, data\-driven products, model integrations, prompt\-based workflows, or AI/ML\-enabled software solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting skills, including debugging application behavior, reviewing logs, resolving defects, and improving application reliability.
* Understanding of security, privacy, performance, resiliency, and maintainability considerations in enterprise software development.
* Ability to work effectively with product, engineering, data science, platform, operations, risk, and governance teams.
* Strong communication, problem\-solving, ownership, and collaboration skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience required.
* Experience in financial services, enterprise technology, or another highly regulated environment.
* Exposure to generative AI, large language models, retrieval systems, agentic workflows, AI\-assisted development, or enterprise AI platforms.
* Experience with cloud platforms, containerization, microservices, DevOps tooling, observability, APIs, data integrations, and production support practices.
* Experience with Python, Java, JavaScript / TypeScript, React, Node.js, SQL / NoSQL databases, APIs, and modern engineering toolchains.
* Familiarity with AI observability, workflow automation, prompt orchestration, model lifecycle tooling, or data pipeline integration is a plus.
